verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile is a client for the GitHub platform. Its core actions (reviewing and merging PRs, triaging issues, assigning work to Copilot) are exposed programmatically through GitHub's documented REST and GraphQL APIs, plus the GitHub CLI and MCP server. However, nothing documents full parity with the UI, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity documentation, evidence that mobile-specific features such as Agent Tasks management and Copilot code review are API-accessible, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Create integrations, retrieve data, and automate your workflows with the GitHub REST API.
The GitHub GraphQL API offers flexibility and the ability to define precisely the data you want to fetch.
use the GitHub Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to interact with repositories, issues, pull requests, and other GitHub features
